bug.title: 商品详情页偶发返回价格翻新前的旧价格
bug.repro: 对同一商品并发触发价格翻新与详情读取：node scripts/repro/price-cache-race.ts --iterations 200，约 5% 的响应携带翻新前的缓存价格

hypotheses.statement: 缓存翻新采用「先删后写」，并发读在删除窗口命中旧副本

result.outputSnippet: AssertionError: expected refreshed price after delete, got stale price read during refresh (198/200 iterations)

hypotheses.statement: Redis 连接池耗尽导致详情接口回退到进程内旧缓存

result.outputSnippet: redis pool exhausted under load, but in-process fallback never triggered; 0/200 responses served from stale local cache

hypotheses.statement: 上游价格服务在发布窗口写入了脏数据（上游访问日志已滚动过期，无法用一条廉价命令区分）
